criteria.requirement: Add explicit keyword-only default_factory=undefined to Config.get and its call shortcut. Invoke a callable factory exactly once only when neither environment nor repository contains the key, then apply the normal cast/bool rules. Empty and None source values are present, not missing. Reject simultaneous default/default_factory and noncallable factories, bound recursive lookup of the same missing key with a safe ValueError, clear the recursion guard even after errors, and preserve the identity of factory exceptions. Existing callable default values must remain ordinary values.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
